preregistered_predictions.exact_model_scope: ATTN_Linear 100 MHz 290 K, Ta blank, source -160 dBm
preregistered_predictions.discriminator: exact unity vs non-unity numerical exports; independent relative diagnostics retain observed residuals
preregistered_predictions.noise_component_test: If report is unity but actual device noise is nonzero and DCP transfer attenuates, report clamp is distinct from physical bypass.
preregistered_predictions.precision_test: Compare 50-digit exponent/log formulas and binary64 rounding to measured errors; no fitted corrections.

limits: Two fresh runs only; six historical cases were read without rerun.

Missing exported device spectrum does not establish physically zero noise.
